collection_notice: Selected FDA announcements; not a complete approval history. Current trial snapshots are separate from event dates.

events.title: Pembrolizumab with chemoradiotherapy for cervical cancer
events.population_summary: FIGO 2014 Stage III-IVA cervical cancer; regimen includes chemoradiotherapy.
evidence_notes: The approval population is Stage III-IVA; the supporting trial also enrolled node-positive Stage IB2-IIB patients.

events.title: Nivolumab with cisplatin and gemcitabine for urothelial carcinoma
events.population_summary: Adults receiving first-line treatment for unresectable or metastatic urothelial carcinoma.
evidence_notes: FDA index date column says March 7, but the announcement states approval on March 6. Use the body approval date.

events.title: Durvalumab with chemotherapy for dMMR endometrial cancer
events.population_summary: Adults with primary advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer that is mismatch repair deficient; carboplatin and paclitaxel followed by durvalumab alone.
evidence_notes: dMMR is an approval population restriction.

events.title: Pembrolizumab with chemotherapy for endometrial carcinoma
events.population_summary: Adults with primary advanced or recurrent endometrial carcinoma; carboplatin and paclitaxel followed by pembrolizumab alone.
evidence_notes: Supporting trial enrolled separate dMMR and pMMR cohorts; the approval paragraph does not restrict to dMMR.

events.title: Perioperative durvalumab for resectable NSCLC
events.population_summary: Adults with resectable NSCLC with tumors at least 4 cm and/or positive nodes; platinum chemotherapy before surgery, followed by durvalumab alone after surgery.
evidence_notes: No known EGFR mutations or ALK rearrangements.

events.title: Atezolizumab and hyaluronidase-tqjs subcutaneous formulation
events.population_summary: Subcutaneous formulation covering the adult indications of intravenous atezolizumab, subject to the specific prescribing information.
evidence_notes: Formulation approval is distinct from a new indication. The comparative trial evaluated pharmacokinetic exposure.

events.title: Pembrolizumab with chemotherapy for pleural mesothelioma
events.population_summary: First-line treatment of unresectable advanced or metastatic malignant pleural mesothelioma with pemetrexed and platinum chemotherapy.
evidence_notes: Pleural mesothelioma; do not broaden this announcement to peritoneal mesothelioma.

events.title: Perioperative nivolumab for resectable NSCLC
events.population_summary: Adults with resectable NSCLC with tumors at least 4 cm and/or positive nodes; platinum-doublet chemotherapy before surgery, followed by nivolumab alone after surgery.
evidence_notes: No known EGFR mutations or ALK rearrangements.

events.title: Durvalumab for limited-stage SCLC
events.population_summary: Adults with limited-stage SCLC whose disease has not progressed after concurrent platinum chemotherapy and radiation.
evidence_notes: Limited-stage disease; do not conflate with extensive-stage SCLC.

events.title: Nivolumab and hyaluronidase-nvhy subcutaneous formulation
events.population_summary: Subcutaneous formulation across specified approved adult solid-tumor nivolumab indications, including monotherapy, maintenance after nivolumab plus ipilimumab, and specified combinations.
evidence_notes: Opdivo Qvantig is not indicated in combination with intravenous ipilimumab. Formulation is distinct from IV Opdivo.

events.title: Pembrolizumab for HER2-positive gastric or GEJ cancer
events.population_summary: Traditional approval with trastuzumab and fluoropyrimidine/platinum chemotherapy for first-line adult locally advanced unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma expressing PD-L1 CPS at least 1.
evidence_notes: Conversion from prior accelerated approval; do not count as a first-ever pembrolizumab approval.

events.title: Perioperative durvalumab for muscle-invasive bladder cancer
events.population_summary: Adults with muscle-invasive bladder cancer; gemcitabine and cisplatin with durvalumab before radical cystectomy, followed by durvalumab alone.
evidence_notes: The supporting trial enrolled radical-cystectomy candidates without prior systemic bladder-cancer treatment.

events.title: Nivolumab plus ipilimumab for MSI-H or dMMR colorectal cancer
events.population_summary: Adults and children aged at least 12 years with unresectable or metastatic MSI-H or dMMR colorectal cancer; nivolumab plus ipilimumab.
evidence_notes: The announcement also converts specified single-agent nivolumab metastatic colorectal cancer accelerated approval to regular approval.

events.title: Nivolumab plus ipilimumab for hepatocellular carcinoma
events.population_summary: Adults receiving first-line treatment for unresectable or metastatic hepatocellular carcinoma.
evidence_notes: The supporting trial required Child Pugh A and ECOG 0 or 1; distinguish trial criteria from the indication paragraph.

events.title: Perioperative pembrolizumab for resectable HNSCC
events.population_summary: Adults with resectable locally advanced HNSCC with PD-L1 CPS at least 1; pembrolizumab before surgery, then with radiotherapy with or without cisplatin, followed by pembrolizumab alone.
evidence_notes: Do not remove the PD-L1 CPS restriction.

events.title: Pembrolizumab and berahyaluronidase alfa-pmph subcutaneous formulation
events.population_summary: Subcutaneous formulation for adult and pediatric patients aged at least 12 years in solid-tumor indications approved for IV pembrolizumab; consult specific labeling.
evidence_notes: Supporting trial excludes EGFR, ALK, and ROS1 aberrations; that trial criterion is not a universal statement for every approved Qlex indication.

events.title: Lurbinectedin plus atezolizumab maintenance for extensive-stage SCLC
events.population_summary: Adults with extensive-stage SCLC without progression after first-line induction with atezolizumab or Hybreza plus carboplatin and etoposide; maintenance with lurbinectedin plus either formulation.
evidence_notes: The cited randomized maintenance trial used IV atezolizumab; the approved announcement includes both formulations.

events.title: Adjuvant cemiplimab for cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma
events.population_summary: Adults with cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma at high recurrence risk after surgery and radiation.
evidence_notes: Trial exclusions include specified autoimmune/immunosuppression and transplantation histories; these are trial criteria.

events.title: Pembrolizumab plus enfortumab vedotin for cisplatin-ineligible MIBC
events.population_summary: Cisplatin-ineligible adults with muscle-invasive bladder cancer; pembrolizumab or Qlex with enfortumab vedotin before surgery and after cystectomy.
evidence_notes: Supporting trial also allowed patients who declined cisplatin, but the approval paragraph specifies cisplatin ineligibility.

events.title: Perioperative durvalumab for resectable gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma
events.population_summary: Adults with resectable gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma; durvalumab with FLOT chemotherapy before and after surgery, followed by durvalumab alone.
evidence_notes: Trial was not designed to isolate the effect of durvalumab in the neoadjuvant versus adjuvant phase.

events.title: Pembrolizumab plus paclitaxel for platinum-resistant ovarian-related carcinoma
events.population_summary: Adults with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian-tube, or primary-peritoneal carcinoma expressing PD-L1 CPS at least 1 after one or two prior systemic regimens; paclitaxel with or without bevacizumab.
evidence_notes: Both IV pembrolizumab and Qlex are named.

events.title: Nivolumab plus AVD for previously untreated classical Hodgkin lymphoma
events.population_summary: Adults and children aged at least 12 years with previously untreated Stage III or IV classical Hodgkin lymphoma; nivolumab with doxorubicin, vinblastine, and dacarbazine.
evidence_notes: The announcement separately grants traditional approval for specified relapsed/refractory adult cHL indications. This hematologic indication should not be inherited by Qvantig from solid-tumor formulation approval.

events.title: Adjuvant atezolizumab for MIBC with ctDNA molecular residual disease
events.population_summary: Adults with muscle-invasive bladder cancer after cystectomy and ctDNA molecular residual disease determined by an FDA-authorized test; IV atezolizumab or Hybreza.
evidence_notes: A companion-diagnostic selection requirement appears in the approval.

events.title: Durvalumab plus BCG for high-risk NMIBC
events.population_summary: Adults with BCG-naive high-risk non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer; durvalumab plus Bacillus Calmette-Guerin.
evidence_notes: BCG-naive population; do not relabel as BCG-unresponsive.

events.title: Belzutifan plus pembrolizumab for adjuvant clear-cell RCC
events.population_summary: Adults with RCC with a clear-cell component and intermediate-high or high recurrence risk after nephrectomy, including specified resected metastatic lesions; belzutifan with pembrolizumab or Qlex.
evidence_notes: Overall-survival data were immature at the protocol prespecified interim analysis.

events.title: Sacituzumab govitecan plus pembrolizumab for first-line TNBC
events.population_summary: Combination indication: adults with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic TNBC expressing PD-L1 CPS at least 10; sacituzumab govitecan with pembrolizumab or Qlex.
evidence_notes: This page announces two indications. ASCENT-03 supports sacituzumab monotherapy in patients unsuitable for PD-1/PD-L1 therapy; ASCENT-04 supports the pembrolizumab combination.

events.title: Pembrolizumab plus enfortumab vedotin expands perioperative MIBC eligibility
events.population_summary: Adults with muscle-invasive bladder cancer who are cystectomy candidates; pembrolizumab or Qlex plus enfortumab vedotin before and after surgery.
evidence_notes: Extends the prior cisplatin-ineligible approval to all MIBC patients who are candidates for cystectomy. Supporting trial enrolled cisplatin-eligible patients.

events.title: Vusolimogene oderparepvec plus nivolumab for melanoma
events.population_summary: Adults with unresectable advanced cutaneous melanoma progressing on a PD-1-blocking antibody regimen; vusolimogene oderparepvec with nivolumab.
evidence_notes: Accelerated approval; confirmatory verification of clinical benefit is required.

events.title: Adjuvant atezolizumab plus chemotherapy for Stage III dMMR colon cancer
events.population_summary: IV atezolizumab with fluoropyrimidine/oxaliplatin for adults and children aged at least 2 years with Stage III dMMR colon cancer; Hybreza combination for adults and children aged at least 12 years weighing at least 40 kg.
evidence_notes: Different pediatric age and weight restrictions apply to the IV and SC formulations.
